item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud gu ru'i thugs bcud las mkha' 'gro seng gdong khros ma'i rgyud las sbyin sreg dug mda' 'bar ba
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshul 'di ni sreg pa'i 'khor lo mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i rgyud las/ sreg byed dug mda' 'bar ba zhes bya ba phyi rabs don du mkha' spyod pa gsang sngags 'chang ba'i gar dbang byang chub rdo rje rtsal gyis mdzad pa bstan pa'i don chen 'byung bar gyur cig/
